why_ai: Litigation and the European Accessibility Act grow demand, but scanners and AI agents keep absorbing audit work.
why_clarity: WCAG is a codified standard with checkable criteria, though conformance only proxies real usability.
why_digital: Audits run on websites and documents remotely; buyers are legal and procurement functions.

why_ai: Real screen reader expertise is paid for, though tooling and partial automation expand coverage.
why_clarity: Each flow completes or fails per screen reader and browser combination, checkable at once.
why_digital: Testers work through live digital flows with assistive software, remotely.

why_ai: Evidence that product teams act on and legal processes respect still needs accountable expert framing.
why_clarity: Which defect stopped a task is attributable, but severity ranking and legal framing vary.
why_digital: Test results in, documented evidence out, delivered to client leadership and counsel.

why_ai: Mechanically detectable checks in a CI pipeline are pure automation.
why_clarity: Each build passes or fails a defined automated check instantly.
why_digital: Code in, pipeline results out, inside engineering tooling.

why_ai: Scanner checks are commoditised; the manual residue is judgment that AI agents increasingly reach.
why_clarity: Each failure is logged against a specific WCAG success criterion using an established methodology.
why_digital: Auditors test sites on screen and deliver conformance reports to compliance buyers.

why_ai: Alt text, captions, transcripts and PDF tagging are generation tasks models already perform in bulk.
why_clarity: High-volume mechanical work with tag and caption checks, though alt-text quality varies.
why_digital: Documents, video and images in; tagged and captioned files out.

why_ai: Contested claims before litigation and advocacy groups need a credible, accountable expert position.
why_clarity: What a script-based remediation achieved is contested, and litigation settles it slowly.
why_digital: Verification runs on websites, reported to legal and procurement buyers.

why_ai: Grouping, routing and ranking four thousand findings is a sorting job software does.
why_clarity: Every audit backlog needs ordering, but blocking impact is partly a judgment call.
why_digital: Findings lists in, ranked engineering backlogs out.

why_ai: Disabled users testing real tasks carries credibility that automated checks cannot match.
why_clarity: A disabled person either completes the task or does not, observed directly.
why_digital: Task flows tested on live digital products, with results reported online.

why_ai: Buyers pay for disabled experts' lived assistive technology experience, which AI cannot credibly substitute.
why_clarity: Whether a site works is judged from years of personal assistive technology use, not a script.
why_digital: Specialists test websites with assistive software and are contracted remotely.

why_ai: Core judgment is skilled, but most hours are clerical capture that tools are absorbing.
why_clarity: Navigate, observe, classify against a WCAG criterion and write up, repeated for weeks.
why_digital: Auditors work keyboard-only and with screen readers on screen, documenting digitally.
